title: Remove reflection-based BaseApiClient endpoint derivation
objective: Eliminate endpoint inference from entity type names and make repository/API calls use explicit endpoint paths or typed API-client methods.
acceptance_criteria: BaseApiClient no longer derives endpoint names with TEntity.toString or replaceAll('Entity', '')
IBaseApiClient and BaseApiClient APIs use explicit endpoint/path inputs or the reflection-based generic methods are removed from active call paths
RepositoryBase and IRepositoryBase are removed or refactored so concrete repositories no longer depend on reflection-derived endpoints
CarnivalBlocksRepository explicitly delegates every public method to ICarnivalBlocksApiClient
MeetingsRepository explicitly delegates every public method to IMeetingsApiClient
No imports of repository_base.dart or irepository_base.dart remain if those files are deleted
Existing public repository method names used by UI/cubits continue to compile
flutter analyze lib/ reports no new errors
deliverables: Updated explicit base API client contract or removed reflection call paths
Updated carnival block repository interface and implementation
Updated meetings repository interface and implementation
Removed or refactored generic repository base files
